title: Hair Liposomes for Thinning Hair: How They Work & Cost

body:
Liposomes are one of the newer ways to deliver active ingredients to the scalp. Patients often ask us what they are, whether they are different from PRP or exosomes, and who they are for. Here is a clear guide.

## What are liposomes?

Liposomes are microscopic spheres with a lipid shell, similar to the membrane of a cell. Because of this shell they can carry active ingredients and protect them on the way to the target. In hair treatments, liposomes are filled with actives such as peptides, growth factors and vitamins that support the hair follicle.

## How does the treatment work?

The liposome solution is placed into the thinning areas of the scalp with fine injections or microneedling. The liposomes help the actives reach the follicles and release them gradually, which supports weakened follicles, reduces shedding and improves density over a course of sessions. See how a session works on our [hair liposomes page](/treatments/hair-liposomes-dubai/).

## Liposomes, PRP or exosomes?

- [PRP](/treatments/hair-prp-dubai/) uses platelets from your own blood and has the longest track record of the three.
- [Exosomes](/treatments/hair-exosomes-dubai/) deliver growth signals from cultured cells, with no blood draw.
- Liposomes deliver a mix of actives in a protective carrier, also with no blood draw.

All three aim to support follicles that are still alive. Your doctor may suggest one of them, or combine them in a single plan, depending on the cause and stage of your hair loss.

## Who is it for?

- Early thinning in men and women
- Shedding, once medical causes such as low iron or thyroid problems have been checked
- A thinning crown or a widening parting
- Supporting your own hair before or after a [hair transplant](/treatments/hair-transplant-dubai/)

It cannot regrow hair where follicles are already gone. In that case, a transplant is the way to restore hair.

## How many sessions?

Most people have a course of 3 sessions about 4 weeks apart, then maintenance if needed. Less shedding is often noticed within a few months, and density improves gradually over 3 to 6 months. We take photos at each visit so you can see the change.

## Prices in Dubai Marina

At Skin & Laser one session is AED 3,500 + VAT, a course of 2 is AED 3,200 + VAT per session and a course of 3 is AED 2,900 + VAT per session. Your plan is confirmed after a doctor checks your scalp. See all [hair loss treatment options](/hair-loss-treatment-dubai/).

Can liposomes be combined with PRP?
Yes. Your doctor may combine scalp treatments in one plan, depending on the cause and stage of your hair loss.
Less shedding is often noticed within a few months; density improves gradually over 3 to 6 months.
Who should not have hair liposomes?
The treatment is not done during pregnancy or breastfeeding, with an active scalp infection, or with some medical conditions.
